tourName: Bestseller Tour India with Nepal, flight included
quote: We have just completed the private Tourradar Bestseller Tour India with Nepal with the local Payless Tours. After our initial enquiry we had a few que
fullReview:
We have just completed the private Tourradar Bestseller Tour India with Nepal with the local Payless Tours. After our initial enquiry we had a few questions and requests for minor adjustments, and they were all dealt with promptly and expertly. The trip itself was organised brilliantly. 
Our driver, Sunil (Suni), was phenomenal in every way. Driving in India and Nepal is unlike anything we have experienced in all our travels with little care for rules of the road. A two-lane road often has three vehicles weaving in and out side by side plus tuk tuks and motorbikes. It is not uncommon to find vehicles and motorbikes coming towards you on the wrong side of the road. Having grown up with the system Suni is an expert in handling every situation.
One thing visitors need to be aware of is not to judge distances and driving times by western expectations. As an example, one 200 km stretch in Nepal took us 7 hours.
On a day-to-day basis Suni was more than just our driver but was a guide and informant. For specific monuments or tourist attractions we were met by local guides and Suni seemed to know them all. We have huge respect for Payless Tours making complicated arrangements ahead of time, but it was Suni who navigated us proficiently day by day.  
On out last day in Delhi we had a different driver, Rohit, who is also an expert with the crazy traffic. To be fair, to us it seems chaotic, but for local drivers it is totally normal and they do have a system that seems to work. We had encountered Rohit once before as he had previously met us at the Nepal border. He was amazing and without his help we would have had serious problems navigating the immigration system.
In summary, we have nothing but praise for Tourradar and Payless Tours and highly recommend them for anyone considering visiting India.

tourName: Taj Mahal & Rajasthan with Royal Stay at Castles
quote:
I traveled to India for a wedding and then wanted to spend a couple weeks exploring Rajasthan. Feedback is based on being a solo female traveler.

I
fullReview:
I traveled to India for a wedding and then wanted to spend a couple weeks exploring Rajasthan. Feedback is based on being a solo female traveler.

Itinerary - I booked Swastik India Journeys’ 11-Day “Taj Mahal and Wildlife with Royal Stay at Castles” and it was a blast! It had the perfect blend of big cities, small towns, and nature. I rode in boats, on trains, in cars, and on elephants.

Driver - Pradeep Singh was my driver the entire time and he was absolutely amazing. Besides being a patient and safe driver, he also shared fascinating details about history and daily life in India, smoothed out itinerary glitches, knew the best times to visit busy tourist spots, was quick to stop for chai breaks, and any shopping needs. He helped me get money at ATMs, arranged laundry service, tweaked schedules and rooming so I could enjoy local events over the new year.  He made it a flawless tour of Rajasthan. 

Hotels - This tour had such a fun variety of hotels. Highlights included Fort Chanwa in Luni (shout out to Babu Lal and his family for a charming tea in their home), the magnificent  Deogarh Mahal palace where I enjoyed some pool time and wandering around the village, and glamping at the Jungle Cave Resort after the safari, which was so unique. Each of these places had entertainment in the evening with campfires, singing, and dancing.

Tour Guides - In each city I had a guide native to the area explain the local attractions and the history behind them. Special shout outs to Prem in Jaipur (knew where to get all the best photos inside the Amber Fort and the City Palace) and Amrit in Agra. Amrit’s telling of the story behind the Taj Mahal literally brought tears to my eyes. He really brought the saga to life!

Activities - I got to do so many exciting things on this tour! Some of the highlights were the jeep safari in Ranthambore National Patk (spotted tons of animals!), dangled off the train from one of my favorite Bollywood numbers (‘Chaiyya, Chaiyya’ from Dil Se), and rode an elephant in Jaipur.

Shopping - I went to India with a specific shopping list of treasures I wanted to bring home. Everything from nicer items like jewelry and bedding sets, down to fun bangles and candies from the local grocery store. Between Pradeep and the local guides, I got everything on my list and they’re all gorgeous. I did have the fine jewelry (diamonds, rubies, emeralds, gold, and silver) appraised when I came home. They were all authentic, valued higher than what I paid for them, and the appraiser was impressed by the craftsmanship and uniqueness. 

I really appreciate the trustworthiness, knowledge, and kindness of the entire team. Booking was easy and Karni in the main office was quick to respond to any questions I had. Five star experience all around!

tourName: Pharaohs Nile Cruise Adventure - Grand GEM Visit – Return Flights Included
quote: The best part of the tour was the incredible itinerary. We got to see the most important ancient Egyptian monuments/sites in a week. The experience wa
fullReview: The best part of the tour was the incredible itinerary. We got to see the most important ancient Egyptian monuments/sites in a week. The experience was amazing in general. Unlike some reviewers mentioned that they felt somewhat rushed, we felt that the time spent at the sites was sufficient/appropriate for the most part. Accommodations and the variety/quality of food on the cruise were good, although not luxurious. I think it’s helpful to indicate in the tour description that early morning departure is expected. In our case, we had to leave at 3:30AM two mornings once for the flight to Luxor and the other time for the bus to Abu Simbel. Other mornings were also quite early, 6:30-7:00, in order to beat the crowds and the afternoon heat, which was necessary and preferable. Good thing is you get to rest in the afternoon on the cruise. I think we got lucky that  the 19 people in our group were all super nice and interesting. Our tour guide was very responsible and knowledgeable, he really tried to give us lots of information about the history and places we visited, however, we had difficulty with his accent therefore didn’t fully benefit from the guided tours. Overall it’s a satisfactory and memorable experience that we would definitely recommend.

Accommodations and the variety/quality of food on the cruise were good, although not luxurious. I think it’s helpful to indicate in the tour description that early morning departure is expected. In our case, we had to leave at 3:30AM two mornings once for the flight to Luxor and the other time for the bus to Abu Simbel. Other mornings were also quite early, 6:30-7:00, in order to beat the crowds and the afternoon heat, which was necessary and preferable. Good thing is you get to rest in the afternoon on the cruise. I think we got lucky that  the 19 people in our group were all super nice and interesting. Our tour guide was very responsible and knowledgeable, he really tried to give us lots of information about the history and places we visited, however, we had difficulty with his accent therefore didn’t fully benefit from the guided tours. Overall it’s a satisfactory and memorable experience that we would definitely recommend.

tourName: West Philippines Classic 14 Day -  One Life Adventures
quote: I have so many words that can describe this trip, and they are all positive! This trip was an AMAZING experience, many thanks to our tour guide Sheena
fullReview: I have so many words that can describe this trip, and they are all positive! This trip was an AMAZING experience, many thanks to our tour guide Sheena! She has been the best tour guide ever, bringing so much positive energy and good vibes to the group. We were a big group on 17 people, but already from day one she brought us together to one big happy family. She started with presenting her expectations to the trip, both to us, to her and what we were gonna see and experience. I appreciate Sheena not just showing us the attractions, but we learned so much about the Filipino culture and met so many heartfelt people. We saw that our respect for the Filipinos and also for their nature and animal life made them really thankful. On earlier tours with other companies I have experienced tourguides having little energy and taking it only as «work». Sheena wasn’t just our guide, telling us what to do and when. She made her a part of the group, getting to know each and every person. She always looked out for us, making sure we had everything we needed. Even before the trip started she was always available on mail answering every big or little question we had. I always felt safe. And even for two weeks with a lot schechlued in the program there were allways good vibes and allways a Sheena smiling (and dancing). It had to be mentioned that this was her second tour, back to back, and I’m impressed how present Sheena was. She organaized family dinner every night, taking us to the most delicious restaurants. I had high expectations, but now I’m impressed of how much planning that is behind the tour and every person who has participated making us feel welcome and looked out for.  From transport, to delicious food, hostels/hotels. It is a high standard and you relay get what you have paid for! This was a life experience, and again I have to give a huge applause to Sheena. What a woman she is. Don’t think twice about this opportunity, go for it because you want regret it!

quote: We recently took a 4 day desert tour with them from Fes to Marrakech. The tour was customized for us as we wanted to cover more spots. Said our tour p
fullReview:
We recently took a 4 day desert tour with them from Fes to Marrakech. The tour was customized for us as we wanted to cover more spots. Said our tour planner helped us with the planning on the customization of the trip as we had our young children with us. We had countless email exchanges with doubts and questions and he patiently answered all of them. We also compared their tour with few other operators and founds theirs to have the best price and activity balance. Said also gave suggestions on things outside the tour.

For our actual tour we had Walid as our driver and tour guide. We were given a Fiat minivan for our family of 4, and the car was perfect. He went above and beyond by recommending great local places to eat, which really helped us experience authentic Moroccan cuisine instead of just tourist spots. Every recommendation was spot on!

Walid was professional, friendly, and always attentive to our needs. He made us feel comfortable, safe, and well taken care of throughout the trip. His knowledge of the area and genuine hospitality truly enhanced our experience. We also appreciated hearing out his own experiences from his Amazighs background. 

All the included meals and the activities in our trip with tremendous. Each of the meal had unique elements which ensured no monotony. The 5 course meal we had at the Sahara Stars desert camp was something we will cherish. We also loved the desert 4x4 tour which included having tea with a nomad family. tourName: Historic Horizons - Egypt 8 Days (5 Stars) GEM VISIT
quote: We are coming to the end of our holiday booked through Tourradar. I must say it was the most unforgettable week in Egypt, celebrating our 45th wedding
fullReview:
We are coming to the end of our holiday booked through Tourradar. I must say it was the most unforgettable week in Egypt, celebrating our 45th wedding anniversary, and it was everything we dreamed of — and more.

From the very beginning, the team at Holiday In Egypt was completely at all our needs. We had an issue with our pick up at airport and Mohamed was contacted an be dealt with it instantly. Every detail was handled with professionalism and care, making the entire experience stress-free and perfectly organised. We felt supported and looked after at every stage of our journey.

Our guide, Tamer, was truly exceptional. His knowledge, passion, and genuine warmth transformed every visit into something extraordinary. He brought the history to life in such a captivating way, sharing stories and insights that made each temple visit even more meaningful. We couldn’t have asked for a better guide — he made our anniversary trip incredibly special, he always went out of his way for each and everyone of us even though it's
Ramadan he was so calm and kind. 

The Nile cruise was absolutely amazing. Sailing along the Nile, waking up to breathtaking views each morning, enjoying excellent food and wonderful service — it was pure magic. The atmosphere was relaxing yet filled with anticipation for the incredible sights ahead.

And the temples… beyond belief. Standing before these ancient wonders is something that simply cannot be put fully into words. The scale, the beauty, the history — each one left us speechless.

Celebrating 45 years of marriage in such a magnificent place was truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Thank you to Holiday In Egypt and to Tamer for making our anniversary so memorable. We highly, highly recommend this experience to anyone considering a trip to Egypt.

This was my first experience with Wanderful holidays and I would highly recommend them when planning vacations. tourName: The Magical Kingdom of Bhutan
quote: I truly could not recommend this trip enough- it was one of the best weeks of my life! I have always dreamed of going to Bhutan, but it totally exceed
fullReview: I truly could not recommend this trip enough- it was one of the best weeks of my life! I have always dreamed of going to Bhutan, but it totally exceeded my expectations... the food, the people, the jaw-dropping views on every corner, the peaceful atmosphere, the spirituality... it was perfect! My guide (Tashi) and driver (Gyeltshen) were so kind and accommodating and I felt so safe and cared for with them (especially as a solo female traveller). Tashi was so knowledgable, interesting and supportive, really considering my needs and interests throughout the trip (by the end of the trip, I really felt like I was travelling with a friend, not just a guide), and Gyeltshen was fantastic at driving on some of the crazy mountain roads! The whole trip ran with complete ease, with a spectacular itinerary allowing for hikes, culture, history , eating and shopping. The hotels were all lovely, with beautiful views, yummy food and amazing staff. Bhutan is an incredibly special place, and this wonderful tour really allowed me to enjoy it to the fullest!

tourName: Essence of Bhutan
quote:
Bhutan was on my Bucket List - Nobu and Nedup from Bhutan Acorn made my stay absolutely perfect and memorable.

 I am used to travelling alone but s
fullReview:
Bhutan was on my Bucket List - Nobu and Nedup from Bhutan Acorn made my stay absolutely perfect and memorable.

 I am used to travelling alone but since this is not possible for Bhutan, I had to hire an agency - wanting a more local and authentic experience (comparing to joining tours operated from Hong Kong) I trusted my trip with Bhutan Acorn. It was a decision well made and I have not regretted my choice for a second.

From early communication with the agency (they are very responsive in whatsapp) to planning my own schedule (yes you can tailor make), to the actual travel experience, everything is very well organized and taken care of. The food, accommodation, transport (ie ur own car), and the daily schedule are all very decent so I could just relax and enjoy every second without worrying about a single thing.

Being a solo female traveller, I felt incredibly safe and comfortable during my stay in Bhutan. Nobu (my guide) and Nedup (my driver) constantly went out of their way to make sure that i felt comfortable (and happy - they always asked me whether im happy) and for that im eternally grateful.

Thank you for sharing with me your lives, your culture, your knowledge, as well as your open heart and mind.

Thank you for treating me as a friend. :)

fullReview:
This tour was incredibly well organized from start to finish. Someone from the company was with us from the moment we landed at the airport, which made everything feel smooth and stress-free. The hotels and the Nile cruise were first class, and the food on the cruise was absolutely delicious.

Our tour guide from Luxor to Aswan, Mr. Ashraf, was truly the highlight of the trip. He was so well spoken, explained everything clearly and passionately, and made the history come alive. He also went above and beyond to take care of everyone in the group…from helping people sort out SIM cards to arranging special excursions seamlessly.

The Egyptian hospitality was amazing throughout. The hot air balloon ride and Abu Simbel excursion are absolute must-dos. It’s astounding how many historic sites we were able to visit in one trip. the entire experience is awe-inspiring.

And most importantly, as a solo female traveler, the country feels safe. I would highly recommend this experience to anyone considering Egypt.

tourName: 7-Day Rwanda Uganda Wildlife and Primate Safari Adventure
quote:
We modified this tour a bit but this was the closest match for this review. 

We're very glad we chose Safari to Gorilla Tours and had a wonderful e
fullReview:
We modified this tour a bit but this was the closest match for this review. 

We're very glad we chose Safari to Gorilla Tours and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. After researching Safari Bookings to compare companies and itineraries we chose S2G because we liked the itinerary options, price point, and they have great reviews. Aron made it very easy to arrange and happily accommodated a change to fit our schedule. Our trip had 2 gorilla treks, one in Rwanda and one in Uganda, a safari in Queen Elizabeth National Park, the Kazinga River Channel safari and the Mabamba Swamp to see the Shoebill stork, with mid-range accommodations (most were beautiful with stunning settings and views). They can provide high-end accommodation if preferred. Our 8 day tour began in Kigali, Rwanda and ended at the Entebbe airport in Uganda. Aron was incredibly responsive throughout the process and responded to my questions with good guidance and kindness. Our driver guide Obed was wonderful. He was warm, friendly, very knowledgeable, a former National Park Ranger, and made sure we had a very enjoyable and easy experience all along the way. We would gladly book with Aron and Safari to Gorilla Tours again. A couple of points that might be helpful to know is 1) to take more money for miscellaneous tips than you think you need. There are many helpful people along the way that you will want to tip and it makes a big difference in their lives, 2) our schedule was ambitious but if we had more time it would have been lovely to stay longer at some of the places and soak in the experience. Happy travels!

tourName: 5 Days Private Golden Triangle India tour from New Delhi
quote: We were a bit nervous about touring in India but our experience with Taj Tours made it a magical and flawless experience.  We booked the tour after a
fullReview:
We were a bit nervous about touring in India but our experience with Taj Tours made it a magical and flawless experience.  We booked the tour after a 2 week cruise ending in Mumbai.  We flew to Delhi and were picked up at our hotel by Mr. Danish, our driver for the week.  Our sedan was clean and new and Mr. Danish was friendly and was so polite and helpful. He opened doors, handled our luggage, made sure we always had water


and was super sharp and professional in his uniform.  Driving is crazy in India, but MR. Danish was super and took good care of us.  Our accommodations for the week were wonderful.  We chose 5 star and weren’t disappointed. All hotels had good restaurants so after long days of sightseeing and travel, we were able to enjoy really good meals.  Excellent guides were provided in each city and all were knowledgeable and personable.  Saeed, in Agra was amazing. He had 35 years of experience and shared it with us, down to knowing where to get the best pictures at the Taj Mahal. He gave us a wonderful history lesson about the the 16th and 17th century India. All guides were very knowledgeable and courteous. Aahil, the Taj principal met with us during the week and constantly kept in touch to ensure all was going well.  
   I was very pleased with Taj Tours and our adventure was seamless and worry free.  I would recommend this tour company to anyone wanting a great travel experience.

tourName: 5 Days – 4 Nights Nile Cruise 5 Star  From Cairo by Flight
quote: Overall it was an excellent time! There was some things that could be improved on like communication. We came in a day early. Our driver was there for
fullReview:
Overall it was an excellent time! There was some things that could be improved on like communication. We came in a day early. Our driver was there for pick up but when we got to the hotel we had no reservation and no place to spend the night. After 36 hours of flying it wasn’t great news. We had to handle the situation ourselves at 3:30 in the morning. Luckily lots of hotels in the area. 
But the tours of Cairo began and we had the great opportunity to meet our first tour guide Sohaila. A lovely young lady with tons of knowledge and patience. With a talent for herding cats that our group certainly was especially in the Grand Egyptian museum. Answer of our all questions and kept us on the schedule so we could see and experiments the pyramids and Giza plateau. Much appreciated.
Then off to Aswan! Some train , some plane. We are all meant by our second guide/ babysitter ( lol) Hassan. Who was unfortunate stuck with us for the next 3 to 4 days. We are very lucky and had started to become a little family by then. People from all over the world and it was quite lovely. And Hassan was our mentor. 
He gave us the schedule and our lessons, with great enthusiasm, knowledge, and care for the subject matter. And sometimes not sure if he was joking or not. No we not really getting up at 4:00 am to go to a site, are we? Yes you are. And he will have the wake up call sent to your room to make sure you make it. If you don’t it’s on you. He wants you to see all of the sites learn about them. He also cares about the preservation of them. Kind, sweet, funny, man, you’d be lucky to have him. 
Then the sad part the group broke off into different tours! We went to Hurghada. Others to different destinations. We absolutely loved Hurghada! All inclusive resort on the Red Sea to get really really spoiled for a few days. Nice end to the trip.

A special mention goes to our guide, Ahmed. He was knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely caring throughout the journey. He explained everything clearly, answered every question with patience, and made sure everyone felt comfortable and included. 
Yes, be prepared for a few very early wake-up calls to visit the temples, they are so many! — but it’s absolutely worth it also you want to avoid the crowd.
On the cruise the food was delicious with plenty of variety, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the staff were consistently friendly and attentive. Overall, a beautiful cruise that I would highly recommend.

Einzig der Begleiter bei der Buss- und Bootstour in den Oman war desinteressiert und unfreundlich, sein "Kommandoton" war unhöflich!
